new_value: Implemented Python slice of R-12-036. bind_coap_udp gains optional multicast_interface (passes aiocoap create_server_context multicast=[iface]); aiocoap joins ff02::1 and routes by Uri-Path, so POST coap://[ff02::1%iface]/sos activates SOS identically to unicast. Verified end-to-end with a real-socket probe on a physical iface before writing the test. Added TestSosMulticast to test_sos_resource.py (real socket, auto-detects multicast-routable iface, skips cleanly when none — loopback excluded since ff02::1 is unroutable on lo; LICHEN_TEST_MCAST_IFACE env override). Reuses existing unicast activation path unchanged (origin sig/seq/rate-limit gates intact). Tests: full coap suite 1896 passed, 1 pre-existing skip, 3 xfailed; SOS file 111 passed; skip path verified; ruff clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) all PASS — NOTE: opencode run reviewer delegation timed out on substantive prompts (plan agent hangs on file reads), so passes were done inline per the documented fallback; grounded against aiocoap internals (messagemanager NON-forcing for multicast, MCAST_ALL, Uri-Path dispatch). C slice (coap_server.c) is a separate follow-up per scoping. Commit 1502f60252.
